title: Let a peer read AGENTS.md and point every worker brief at the expertise depth layer
judge_obligation_ack: session_init.rs changes only a test that pins preamble text, no guard logic; the separate tester cell pbc-3 is the independent read
action: D1: in packages/bee/prompts/peer-boot.md replace the line 'Do not read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or bee process docs. The brief is complete. If something is missing, report what is missing.' with two lines: one telling the peer to read AGENTS.md first because it holds this project's hard rules (search tools, comments, secrets), and one forbidding CLAUDE.md, .bee/LEADER.md and bee process docs, keeping 'The brief is complete. If something is missing, report what is missing.' D2: in packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md add ONE line under the Inputs block, outside every {{#if}} so both native and herding renders carry it, saying: depth on demand — when a principle line or the cell's work needs more than the brief, follow that principle's Depth line or route .bee/expertise/INDEX.md and read only the one guide section it names; never load the whole shelf. Keep the AGENTS.md input line as it is. Mirror both prompt files byte-for-byte into .bee/bin/prompts/ (use bee dev regen if it owns that copy; check bee dev regen --help). Update any test in session_init.rs or drivers/tests.rs that pins the old peer-boot text or the rendered worker prompt. Sync docs/knowledge/areas/bee-herding/thin-peer-boot.md (the preamble section names that the peer reads AGENTS.md, citing peer-brief-craft D1) and the worker-brief part of docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/dispatch.md (the depth line, citing peer-brief-craft D2). Run bee dev regen inside this cell after the prompt edits and commit what it writes. One commit.
